description: Browse the public RFQ board: requests you can quote with respond_to_rfq (your own appear too). Returns the 100 newest requests that are open or negotiating, each with rfqId, direction, amounts, assets, ask price and expiry. Filters are optional and combine with AND. Private orders never appear here; read one with get_rfq and the id from its link.

base_asset.description: Filter by base asset ("SYMBOL@chain" or id)

direction.description: sell_base: the requester gives the base asset; buy_base: the requester receives it

name: list_open_rfqs

error.description: Set instead when the call failed

title: Browse the RFQ board
